title: Outside Food Policy
content: No outside food or drinks are allowed near the gaming stations. We sell energy drinks and snacks at the front desk. Spilling liquid or any food item on a keyboard/mouse/monitor or any computer items results in a flat ₹5000 base fine plus reservicing cost of the product if damaged.

title: Valorant FPS Drop Troubleshooting
content: If you experience FPS drops in Valorant on the Standard Tier PCs, press ALT+Z to open the NVIDIA overlay and ensure background recording is turned off. Do not attempt to physically unplug the GPU.

title: Cancellation and Refunds
content: Cancellation refund tiers based on time before session start: 1) Cancelled more than 24 hours before: Full 100% refund. 2) Cancelled between 6 hours and 24 hours before: 75% refund. 3) Cancelled between 2 hours and 6 hours before: 50% refund. 4) Cancelled within 2 hours of start time: 0% refund (entire amount forfeited).
